newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Farmer sales pressure bids.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat-Farmer sales pressure bids.

text.p: Some dark northern spring wheat bids in U.S. cash markets were lower Tuesday, with dealers noting moderate grain sales.
"We saw a little bit of grain move today," said a Montana dealer. "But a lot of the farmers, especially in eastern Montana, are waiting for rain and won't sell any wheat until they get some."

Analysts are looking for the U.S. Department of Agriculture to show a modest increase in white wheat production when it releases its next winter wheat production report on Thursday at 0730 CDT/1230 GMT.
An average of analysts' estimates put U.S. white wheat production at 267 million bushels, up from USDA's previous forecast of 259 million.
